title: TimoshQ's Brick Tweak
description: Tweaks the brick recipe to give 4 blocks instead of 1
body:
### This simple mod tweaks the brick recipe to give 4 blocks instead of 1
because if you are anything like me, you probably found the recipe to craft bricks to be way too costly to use for when building any projects of moderate size. 

⚠️This is a somewhat early version, there aren't any bugs that I am aware of after a while of testing. However do expect a lot of updates soon, for example there is currently no Config for the amount given, but I do plan to add it in the following days
